component.name: StarCLX
component.summary: Free client for STARFACE phone systems
Client libre pour les systèmes téléphoniques STARFACE
Client libero per i centralini STARFACE

description.p: StarCLX connects to STARFACE phone systems from version 10 and brings the features of the official desktop app to Linux.
StarCLX verbindet sich mit STARFACE-Telefonanlagen ab Version 10 und bringt die Funktionen der offiziellen Desktop-App auf Linux.

ul.li: Softphone with encrypted calls (SIP/TLS, SRTP) and a call manager: hold, mute, transfer, conference, Call2Go
Softphone mit verschlüsselten Gesprächen (SIP/TLS, SRTP) und Call Manager: halten, stumm, verbinden, Konferenz, Call2Go
Search across all address books while typing, create and edit contacts
Suche beim Tippen über alle Adressbücher, Kontakte anlegen und bearbeiten
Call list with filters, notes and missed-call notifications
Rufliste mit Filtern, Notizen und Benachrichtigung bei verpassten Anrufen
Chat with colleagues, including presence and history
Chat mit Kollegen mit Präsenz und Verlauf
Voicemail, function keys, call forwarding and iFMC
Voicemail, Funktionstasten, Umleitungen und iFMC
Ringtones, audio devices, Kuando Busylight, tray icon and tel: links
Klingeltöne, Audiogeräte, Kuando Busylight, Symbol im Infobereich und tel:-Links

description.p: StarCLX is not affiliated with STARFACE GmbH. STARFACE is a trademark of its owner and is only used to describe compatibility.
StarCLX ist nicht mit der STARFACE GmbH verbunden. STARFACE ist eine Marke ihres Inhabers und wird nur zur Beschreibung der Kompatibilität genannt.

screenshot.caption: Call manager during an outgoing call, with function keys and call list

ul.li: The + for a new view only shows while editing the layout
Free layout: several views, chosen from a bar on the left; + adds a new view
Views can be renamed, given an icon, reordered and deleted while editing
Call list: new "Mine" switch hides group calls that were missed or answered by someone else
Call list: new "Answered" filter
Contact details in the address book show name, address, email and website
Function keys use the full window width
Answering a call in StarCLX no longer also answers it in another client signed in to the same account
Reconnects reliably to the PBX and the softphone after a long standby
Device list selection and own chat messages are readable again in the light theme
Calls stay on the selected audio device even when a Bluetooth headset is connected in its hands-free profile
Call audio and microphone reliably use the selected device again, also after a Bluetooth profile switch or a PipeWire restart
The minimised main window opens again from the tray on X11
Bluetooth headsets set as the system default also switch to the telephony profile during calls
Bluetooth headsets switch to the telephony profile already while ringing, so their button answers the call
New setting to choose whether play/pause acts as the call button
Run several StarCLX instances at once, one per PBX, each with its own coloured icon
The main window works down to 600 x 480 pixels
The play/pause button of Bluetooth headsets answers and ends calls
Bluetooth headsets switch to the telephony profile during calls
Jabra Link 380 and similar headsets are recognised with their telephony buttons
Sign-in only sends credentials over HTTPS
New Recordings view for call recordings stored on the PBX
Switch between several saved accounts without signing in again
Live iQueue view: waiting callers, sign in and out, pick up a waiting call
A single notice instead of errors in every module when the PBX is unreachable
Features the user has no PBX permission for are hidden instead of failing
Reworked call list, custom accent colour and borderless workspace tiles
Dial via your desk phone when it is the primary phone; the call manager controls calls without the softphone
Global shortcuts also work on KDE Plasma and other desktops with the GlobalShortcuts portal
Administrators can preset or lock settings system-wide in /etc/xdg/starclxrc
All call forwardings can be changed in the settings, even without a function key
Chat no longer shows conversations of a previously signed-in account
Door intercoms: camera picture in the call window, open the door during the call, door camera tile
Function keys for group login and module activation let you pick groups and modules
Call details in the call list, with callback mark and comment
Settings split into tabs; change your profile picture and password
Accidental zooming by touchpad or Ctrl+wheel is blocked
Function keys show phone, do-not-disturb, chat status, redirect and the user's picture like the STARFACE app
Switch keys for do not disturb, modules, redirects, caller ID, group login and callback on busy
Profile menu with status, primary phone, caller ID and redirects
Own chat status with saved custom statuses, kept in sync with other clients
Chat stays connected on cloud phone systems
Sign-in works without a keyring
Sign-in to phone systems on the STARFACE cloud services
Softphone for users without the auto-provisioning permission
